intro_en: You will learn to read and discuss news about how Ulaanbaatar is solving its problems, using news-style causative verbs and nouns ending in -лт and -лга. You will also review too, enough, much and many.
intro_mn: Та Улаанбаатар хот асуудлаа хэрхэн шийдэж байгаа тухай мэдээг унших, ярилцах, мөн мэдээний хэлбэрийн үйлдүүлэх хэв болон -лт, -лга нөхцөлтэй нэр үгийг сурна. Мөн "too, enough, much, many"-г давтана.

vocab.example_mn: Гэр хороололд шинэ цахилгаан шугам татна.
vocab.example_en: A new power line will be laid in the ger district.
The price of fuel has gone up.
A new bus line has opened.
There is a plan to build a metro in Ulaanbaatar.

vocab.example_mn: Айл өрхүүд цэвэр түлш хэрэглэж байна.

vocab.example_en: This building will be finished next year.
The city administration issued a new regulation.
Some families were relocated to new apartments.
Central heating serves most apartment buildings.

sentences.mn: Хотын захиргаа гэр хороололд шинэ цахилгаан шугам татуулав.
sentences.en: The city administration had a new power line laid in the ger district.
alt_mn: Хотын захиргаа гэр хороололд шинэ цахилгаан шугам татууллаа.
alt_en: City hall had a new power line installed in the ger district.
sentences.mn_latin: Khotyn zakhirgaa ger khoroolold shine tsakhilgaan shugam tatuulav.

sentences.en: Many families were relocated to new apartments.
alt_en: Many households were moved into new apartments.

sentences.en: Traffic lights were installed near the school.
alt_en: Traffic lights were put in near the school.

sentences.en: The plan to have a metro built was approved.
alt_en: They approved the plan to get a metro built.

sentences.en: Smoke will decrease as a result of using clean fuel.
alt_en: Using clean fuel will reduce the smog.

sentences.mn: Агаарын чанарт хяналт тавих ажил эхэллээ.
sentences.en: Work on monitoring air quality has begun.
alt_en: The air quality monitoring work has started.
sentences.mn_latin: Agaaryn chanart khyanalt tavikh ajil ekhellee.

sentences.en: The winter heating is not enough.

sentences.mn: Хотод хэт олон машин байгаа учраас түгжрэл их байна.
sentences.en: There are too many cars in the city, so the traffic is heavy.
alt_en: The city has too many cars, so there are bad traffic jams.
sentences.mn_latin: Khotod khet olon mashin baigaa uchraas tügjrel ikh baina.

sentences.mn: Шинэ шугам хангалттай олон хүн тээж чадахгүй.
sentences.en: The new line cannot carry enough people.
alt_en: The new line can't carry a sufficient number of people.
sentences.mn_latin: Shine shugam khangalttai olon khün teej chadakhgüi.

sentences.mn: Хэт их утаа хүүхдийн эрүүл мэндэд муу.
sentences.en: Too much smoke is bad for children's health.
alt_en: Too much smog is bad for children's health.
sentences.mn_latin: Khet ikh utaa khüükhdiin erüül mended muu.

sentences.en: The new construction work was finished quickly.
alt_en: The new building work was completed quickly.

grammar.explain_en: Mongolian causative suffixes (-УУЛ-, -ГУУЛ-, -ЛГА-) show that someone arranges for something to be done: суух → суулгах (to install), татах → татуулах (to have laid), барих → бариулах (to have built). News reports love the short past ending -в: нүүлгэв, суулгуулав ('was relocated', 'had installed'). The long form барьж байгуулуулах means 'to have built'. Verbs can also become nouns with -лт or -лга: хянах → хяналт (monitoring), тээвэрлэх → тээвэрлэлт (transport), халаах → халаалт (heating), барих → барилга (building). Review: 'too much/too many' = хэт их / хэт олон; 'enough' = хангалттай.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлний "have something done" бүтэц Монгол хэлний үйлдүүлэх хэвтэй төстэй: The city had a line installed. Мэдээнд үйлдэгч нь ихэвчлэн нэрлэгддэггүй, "were relocated" шиг үйлийг өнгөрсөн цагаар өгүүлнэ. Нэр үг үйл үгээс үүснэ: monitor → monitoring, transport → transportation, heat → heating. Давтлага: too much (тоологдохгүй) – too much smoke; too many (тоологдох) – too many cars; enough – нэр үгийн өмнө: enough buses; тэмдэг нэрийн дараа: big enough.

examples.en: The families were relocated to a new district.
The administration had cameras installed on the street.

fill_blank.text: Хотын захиргаа гэр хороололд шинэ шугам татуу___.
fill_blank.translation: The city administration had a new line laid in the ger district.
fill_blank.explain_en: Past news style: causative stem татуул- + -в, joined as татуулав.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Мэдээнд өнгөрсөн цагийг -в нөхцөлөөр илэрхийлнэ: татуулав.

fill_blank.translation: The monitoring of air quality has improved.
fill_blank.explain_en: A noun is needed here: хяналт (monitoring), from хянах.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Нэр үг хэрэгтэй тул хянах → хяналт.

fill_blank.translation: The central heating is warm enough.
fill_blank.explain_en: халаалт is the noun 'heating', from халаах.

fill_blank.text: There are ___ cars on the road, so traffic is slow.
fill_blank.translation: Замд хэт олон машин байгаа тул хөдөлгөөн удаан байна.
fill_blank.explain_en: Cars are countable, so use 'too many'.
Smoke is uncountable, so use 'too much'.

fill_blank.text: The new metro is not big ___ for the whole city.
fill_blank.translation: Шинэ метро хотыг бүхэлд нь хамрахад хангалттай том биш.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'Enough' comes after the adjective: big enough.
fill_blank.explain_mn: enough тэмдэг нэрийн ард орно: big enough.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Өнөөдрийн мэдээг уншсан уу? Хотын захиргаа шинэ шугам татуулжээ.
dialogue.en: Did you read today's news? The city administration had a new line laid.
dialogue.mn_latin: Önöödriin medeeg unshsan uu? Khotyn zakhirgaa shine shugam tatuuljee.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ, гэр хороололд. Мөн цэвэр түлш хэрэглэхийг дэмжиж байна.
dialogue.en: Yes, in the ger district. They are also supporting the use of clean fuel.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee, ger khoroolold. Mön tsever tülsh khereglekhiig demjij baina.

dialogue.speaker: Сара
dialogue.mn: Сайн хэрэг. Гэхдээ утаа хэт их хэвээр байна шүү.
dialogue.en: That's good. But there is still too much smog.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain khereg. Gekhdee utaa khet ikh kheveer baina shüü.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Тийм. Метро барьж байгуулуулах төлөвлөгөөг ч баталсан.
dialogue.en: True. They also approved a plan to have a metro built.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim. Myetro barij baiguuluulakh tölövlögöög ch batalsan.

dialogue.speaker: Сара
dialogue.mn: Хэзээ дуусах юм бол? Одоо автобус хангалттай биш.
dialogue.en: When will it be finished? Right now there aren't enough buses.
dialogue.mn_latin: Khezee duusakh yum bol? Odoo avtobus khangalttai bish.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Хэдэн жил болно. Тэр хүртэл нийтийн тээврийг сайжруулна гэсэн.
dialogue.en: It will take several years. Until then they say they will improve public transport.
dialogue.mn_latin: Kheden jil bolno. Ter khürtel niitiin teevriig saijruulna gesen.

dialogue.speaker: Сара
dialogue.mn: Ямар ч байсан сайн хяналт тавиасай.
dialogue.en: Anyway, I hope they keep a close eye on it.
dialogue.mn_latin: Yamar ch baisan sain khyanalt taviasai.

culture_note.en: Ulaanbaatar is home to nearly half of Mongolia's population, and winter smog from coal-burning ger district stoves is a major issue. The city has moved families into apartments, supplied cleaner fuel, and discussed building a metro. News about these projects often uses short formal verbs such as нүүлгэв and суулгуулав.
culture_note.mn: Улаанбаатарт Монгол Улсын хүн амын бараг тал нь амьдардаг бөгөөд гэр хорооллын нүүрсний зуухнаас үүдэлтэй өвлийн утаа томоохон асуудал юм. Хот айлуудыг орон сууцанд нүүлгэж, цэвэр түлшээр хангаж, метро барих тухай ярьж байна. Эдгээр төслийн мэдээнд нүүлгэв, суулгуулав зэрэг товч албан ёсны үйл үг түгээмэл хэрэглэгддэг.

review.notes: Mostly good; a few real errors (хорооллд spelling, dangling English gloss, causative derivation in explanation); several no-op entries listed can be ignored.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed the -лт/-лга mismatch, unnatural translations, the fill-in-the-blank distractors and some dialogue wording.

changes.why: The lesson's nouns (хяналт, тээвэрлэлт, халаалт) end in -лт, not -лга
Matches the -лт nouns taught in the lesson
'-алт' is not a separate suffix; added an -лга example
The old distractors made non-words; the new ones form real verb forms, and only the past form fits
'түгжрэл удаан' is unnatural; 'traffic is slow' = хөдөлгөөн удаан
'бүх хотод' means 'for all cities', not 'for the whole city'
'Сайн байна' sounds like a greeting; 'That's good' = Сайн хэрэг
Bus service is нийтийн тээвэр; тээвэрлэлт means freight or conveyance
'хяналтаа ... тавьж байгаасай' is awkward; this is the natural wish form
More natural English than 'keep good oversight'
